people.name: José María Velasco Ibarra
people.nameZh: 何塞·瑪麗亞·貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉

body.zh-Hant: 貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉生於1893年3月19日。他的父親是工程師、數學家兼國會議員，母親德莉亞·伊瓦拉是玻利瓦爾副官的後裔。他在基多的中央大學法學院求學，其後到巴黎索邦就讀。他以筆名「拉布里奧勒」在《商報》上發表了數百篇文章。
body.en: Velasco Ibarra was born on 19 March 1893. His father was an engineer, mathematician and national deputy, and his mother, Delia Ibarra, was descended from Simón Bolívar's aides-de-camp. He was trained in law at the Central University in Quito and later studied at the Sorbonne in Paris. Under the pseudonym Labriolle he published hundreds of articles in the newspaper El Comercio.

heading.en: Congress and the road to the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉1932年當選國會議員，1933年出任眾議院議長，約一年後接替共和國總統。此後他主導國家政治近半世紀。
body.en: Velasco Ibarra was elected to Congress in 1932 and became president of the Chamber of Deputies in 1933. About a year later he replaced the president of the republic. He went on to dominate national politics for nearly five decades.

citations.quote: elected to Congress in 1932, became president of the Chamber of Deputies in 1933
and replaced the president of the republic a year later
Velasco dominated national politics for nearly five decades

body.zh-Hant: 貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉五度出任厄瓜多爾總統，任期為1934至1935年、1944至1947年、1952至1956年、1960至1961年、1968至1972年。他四度被強行驅離職位，只有1952至1956年的第三個任期依憲法規定走完。另據一篇學術論文，他曾於1935、1946與1970年三度宣布自任獨裁者。
body.en: Velasco Ibarra was president of Ecuador five times, in 1934-1935, 1944-1947, 1952-1956, 1960-1961 and 1968-1972. He was forcibly removed on four occasions, and only his third presidency (1952-1956) was completed in accordance with constitutional provisions. According to a scholarly article, he declared himself dictator on three occasions: 1935, 1946 and 1970.

citations.quote: He attained the presidency five times but was forcibly removed on four occasions
Only his third presidency (1952–1956) was completed
Se declaró dictador por tres ocasiones (1935, 1946 y 1970)

body.zh-Hant: 貝拉斯科·伊瓦拉是一位極具魅力的演說家，一生批評政黨，靠個人的選舉機器贏得權力。1968年險勝後展開的第五任也是最後一任，最終以軍方介入告終，他隨即流亡，曾在多個拉丁美洲國家自我流放，主要在阿根廷。1979年他返回厄瓜多爾安葬妻子，一個月後去世，卒於1979年3月30日。
body.en: Velasco Ibarra was a spellbinding orator and a lifelong critic of political parties, winning power through a personal electoral machine. His fifth and final term, after a narrow victory in 1968, ended when the military intervened, and he went into exile, living in several Latin American countries, chiefly Argentina. He returned in 1979 to bury his wife and died a month later, on 30 March 1979.

body.zh-Hant: 布勒蒂亞努1864年8月20日生於弗洛里卡（今 Ștefănești），是政治人物 I. C. 布勒蒂亞努的長子。他在布加勒斯特聖薩瓦學院畢業後，赴巴黎的橋路學校求學，成為工程師，參與切爾納沃達橋與巴克烏—皮亞特拉尼亞姆茨鐵路的修建。他的政治生涯始於1895年，先任議員，其後出任公共工程部長。
body.en: Brătianu was born on 20 August 1864 in the village of Florica (now Ștefănești), the eldest son of the politician I. C. Brătianu. After finishing his studies at the Sf. Sava College in Bucharest he studied at the Roads and Bridges School in Paris and became an engineer, working on the Cernavodă bridge and the Bacău–Piatra Neamț railways. His political career began in 1895, first as a deputy and then as Minister of Public Works.

heading.en: Party leader and wartime prime minister

body.zh-Hant: 1909年1月24日，國家自由黨大會選布勒蒂亞努為黨主席。依羅馬尼亞政府的首相名單，他自1908年12月27日起組閣，另有1909年3月4日至1910年12月28日、1914年1月4日至1916年12月11日、1916年12月11日至1918年1月26日，以及1918年11月26日至1919年9月27日的任期。1919年2月1日，他以羅馬尼亞代表團團長身分在巴黎和會上陳述羅馬尼亞參戰的理由。
body.en: On 24 January 1909 the National Liberal Party congress elected Brătianu its president. According to the Romanian government's list of prime ministers, he formed a government from 27 December 1908, and further terms ran from 4 March 1909 to 28 December 1910, from 4 January 1914 to 11 December 1916, from 11 December 1916 to 26 January 1918, and from 26 November 1918 to 27 September 1919. On 1 February 1919, as head of the Romanian delegation at the Paris Peace Conference, he set out the reasons for Romania's entry into the war.

4 January 1914 – 11 December 1916

body.zh-Hant: 1922年1月19日至1926年3月27日，布勒蒂亞努再度擔任首相，1927年6月21日又組閣至11月24日。戰後他推動的改革與立法包括土地改革、1923年憲法與行政法。他於1927年11月24日猝逝，他的死對國家自由黨造成嚴重問題。
body.en: Brătianu was prime minister again from 19 January 1922 to 27 March 1926, and formed a further government from 21 June to 24 November 1927. The reforms and laws he promoted after the First World War included the agrarian reform, the Constitution of 1923 and the Administration Law. He died suddenly on 24 November 1927, his death posing a serious problem for the National Liberal Party.

body.zh-Hant: 特特雷斯庫（Gheorghe Tătărescu）生於1886年、卒於1957年，德國國家圖書館的權威記錄稱他為羅馬尼亞政治人物。羅馬尼亞國家極權研究所（INST）傳記辭典的條目摘要稱他政治立場屬自由派，兩次大戰之間曾擔任多個部會職務。
body.en: Gheorghe Tătărescu was born in 1886 and died in 1957; the authority record of the German National Library describes him as a Romanian politician. body.zh-Hant: 依羅馬尼亞政府網站的歷任首相名單，特特雷斯庫領導六個內閣：1934年1月5日至10月1日、1934年10月2日至1936年8月29日、1936年8月29日至1937年11月14日、1937年11月17日至12月28日，以及1939年11月24日至1940年5月11日、1940年5月11日至7月4日。
body.en: According to the Romanian government's list of prime ministers, Tătărescu led six governments: 5 January to 1 October 1934, 2 October 1934 to 29 August 1936, 29 August 1936 to 14 November 1937, 17 November to 28 December 1937, 24 November 1939 to 11 May 1940, and 11 May to 4 July 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年，特特雷斯庫加入彼得魯·格羅查政府，任部長會議副主席兼外交部長。1947年11月他被逐出政府並被強制居住；1950年5月5至6日夜間被捕。他於1957年3月28日去世。
body.en: In 1945 Tătărescu joined the Petru Groza government as vice-president of the Council of Ministers and as foreign minister. In November 1947 he was removed from the government and placed under forced domicile; he was arrested on the night of 5-6 May 1950. He died on 28 March 1957.
